nerdy hobbies that make
you smarter every week

reading old letters

read the published letters of famous writers and scientists. their private words show how great minds really doubted, argued and changed their minds over time.

one lesson a day

i used to only know my own subject until a daily lesson opened up everything else. a few minutes of art, history and science each day made me sharper week after week.
slides.texte_sophia:
one lesson a day

i used to only know my own subject. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, art, history, science, and i get a little smarter every single week.

slides.texte_overlay:
learning cloud types

learn the names of ten kinds of cloud and spot them on your walks. it trains your attention, and the sky turns into something you can actually read and enjoy.

translating songs

translate the lyrics of a song in a language you don't speak. you pick up words, grammar and a bit of culture at once, and the song means so much more.

memory palaces

picture a familiar room and place things you want to remember inside it. this ancient trick is how memory champions learn long lists, and anyone can do it.
